profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Manufacturing Ops | Master of Natural Science in Biology
profile.summary:
Multidisciplinary professional with a background in biology and a strong foundation in data analysis, project coordination, and technical communication. Skilled at translating complex information into actionable insights and collaborating across diverse teams.

I’ve recently expanded my technical skill set through an intensive full-stack web development program, where I built user-centered applications using Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, SQL, and modern API-driven architectures. My work is strongly informed by UX principles, and I care deeply about building interfaces that feel intuitive, intentional, and human.

I thrive at the intersection of logic and creativity, and I’m excited to keep growing as a developer while building thoughtful, well-designed software that actually serves its users.
